references.text: Moses also asks God here to blot him out of His book, showing a similar desperation and willingness to die for the sake of the people.
Elijah prays to die under a broom bush, a parallel to Moses' wish for death due to the burden of his service.
Jonah also asks God to take his life, similar to Moses' prayer to be killed rather than see his own ruin.
Jonah repeats his desire for death, showing the same kind of frustration and exhaustion that Moses experienced.
Job also expresses a wish that God would take his life, similar to Moses' desperation in his suffering.
Jeremiah curses the day he was born and expresses deep despair over his service, similar to Moses' wish to be relieved of his burden through death.
